family_guard.selection: train weighted score, dev veto (zero drift ruin + 95% margin)

provenance.export_note: Runtime artifact for the submitted family-guard router. Every head, the recalibration and the Premium path are byte-copied from the feasibility-ladder artifact. The only additions are the raised Fast and Balanced caps and the per-family accounting multipliers, both selected on Train and confirmed once on Dev. No Dev path was opened, hashed, parsed or scored while fitting.

recalibration.production: Single full-fit transform learned on Train only. The predicted incremental cost is the out-of-fold cost-head ax31-light increment; the actual incremental cost comes from Train outcomes. Episodes are split into 10 equal-count bins over a stable argsort, each bin factor is sum(actual) / sum(predicted), the factors are forced non-increasing by pool-adjacent-violators weighted by the predicted sums, and the result is clipped to [0.5, 6.0]. Inference places a prediction with digitize(right=True) and clips the bin index to 0..9. The runtime applies these frozen edges and factors and never refits. No Dev input, outcome, hash or score was read to produce this block.
